title: Exact localization data on a single scheme
statement: For a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ with its recorded integers and uniformizer, and any scheme $X$, LocalizationData for $B_X\to B_X[1/t]$ is nonempty [def-tw-lisse-localization-data]. Thus exact scalar extension has a counit-normalized derived comparison, the natural formula for all unbounded cohomology groups, and additive raw rational descent with the recorded tensor scalar formula and preservation of both localized standard halves. This assertion contains no chart comparisons or local-freeness conclusion.

source.place: Lemma 6.8.2, Definitions 6.8.3 and 6.8.8; source restriction and exact scalar localization in Proposition 6.8.14(2)

proof.text: Choose a universal cochain model for the specified ring map. Apply continuous coefficient derived localization to the compatible constant scalar map. Uniqueness of algebra maps out of the localization identifies its coefficient isomorphism with the recorded sfRationalCoefficientEquiv.

The natural normalized exact comparison and its cohomology isomorphisms provide the ordinary and derived fields. Apply its raw rational descent to the full integral constructible subcategory, using the inherited constant scalar action.

For either rational standard half take its defining integral representative and rational isomorphism. Exact cohomology comparison kills the forbidden degrees; realization of the rational isomorphism transfers this vanishing. The two representatives need not coincide.
